messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have a way to pull that data directly. However, here’s a quick summary of the federal holidays that create long‑weekend opportunities in Canada for 2023:

| Date | Holiday | Observed (if different) | Typical long‑weekend |
|------|---------|--------------------------|---------------------|
| Jan 1 | New Year’s Day | – | (Observed on Jan 2, Monday) |
| Jan 2 | Observed New Year’s Day | – | Dec 31 – Jan 2 |
| Apr 7 | Good Friday | – | Apr 7 – 9 |
| May 22 | Victoria Day | – | May 20 – 22 |
| Jul 1 | Canada Day | Observed on Jul 3 (Monday) | Jul 1 – 3 |
| Sep 4 | Labour Day | – | Sep 2 – 4 |
| Oct 9 | Thanksgiving | – | Oct 7 – 9 |
| Nov 11 | Remembrance Day | – | Nov 11 – 13 |
| Dec 25 | Christmas Day | – | Dec 23 – 25 |
| Dec 26 | Boxing Day | – | Dec 26 – 28 |

These dates give you the core long‑weekend windows you’ll see across most provinces in 2023. If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., Family Day in Ontario or St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador), let me know and I can add those too.
